records.title: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
details: a to c: The concurrent evaluation study of the PM Vishwakarma Scheme has been initiated and is currently being conducted by IIM, Mumbai.

records.title: Progress in Power Generation
details: a to b: In addition to above, NTPC Green Energy Limited (NGEL), a wholly owned subsidiary of NTPC Ltd., is also in the process of setting up a Green Hydrogen Hub in the state of Andhra Pradesh, to produce Green Hydrogen for production of Green Chemicals (Ammonia, Methanol, Sustainable Aviation Fuel/Green Urea). A pilots project for demonstration of methanol firing (instead of Naphtha) at NTPC Kayamkulam Gas Plant in Kerala has been awarded by NTPC Ltd to BHEL.

records.title: Renovation of Meerut City Station.
details: Final Location Survey of Meerut-Hastinapur-Bijnor (63.5 Km) new line has been sanctioned for preparation of Detailed Project Report (DPR).

records.title: EXPANSION OF DOMESTIC FLIGHT SERVICES.
details: b: The Government has accorded in-principle approval for development of Jewar (Noida) Airport in West Uttar Pradesh, which is under construction. Besides, 18 (Eighteen) airports have been identified for development under the RCS UDAN Scheme in the state of Uttar Pradesh till now. 12 Airports namely Agra. Prayagraj, Bareilly, Kanpur, Hindon, Kushinagar, Aligarh, Azamgarh, Shravasti, Moradabad and Chitrakoot and Ayodhya airport
